description:
Get Instagram Posts

Fetches the latest posts of a public Instagram account by username (handle) and returns each post with caption, hashtags, mentions, image URL, and publish date. Supports token-based pagination via nextPageToken to walk older posts. Use to monitor competitor content, track engagement of creator posts, or build datasets of account content for vetting and analytics.

handle.description: The Instagram username of the account whose posts you want to scrape, without the `@` symbol.

limit.description: The maximum number of posts to retrieve per request. Defaults to 12.

nextPageToken.description: Defines the next page token. It is used for retrieving the next page results. Use the `nextPageToken` value returned by the previous response.
